text: Our security team will block the rollout unless we can rotate API keys without any downtime for the driver app.
We hit the rate limit every Monday morning when the weekly routes are optimized in one batch.
Legal needs written confirmation that driver data stays inside the EU before we sign.
We missed deliveries because webhook events for the same route showed up out of order in our old vendor.
The team wants one read-only key for the analytics dashboard so nobody can cancel a route by accident.
At peak we send around four thousand requests per minute, so the default limit is a blocker for the pilot.
